# Raynes & Lawn

> A premier Pennsylvania and New Jersey trial law firm specializing in personal injury, medical malpractice, and complex litigation with billions in recoveries.

Founded in 1969 by Arthur G. Raynes, Raynes & Lawn is a leading civil litigation firm with offices in Philadelphia, PA and Marlton, NJ. The firm is recognized by Super Lawyers and Best Lawyers in America, featuring trial attorneys with decades of experience in landmark cases and high-value verdicts.
